name: Platform.h
summary: Defines the abstract Platform interface that exposes all OS-specific operations (networking, serial I/O, system metrics, GPU info, dialogs) required by the agent, allowing platform-specific implementations to be swapped behind a common API.

name: SystemState.h
summary: Defines the NetworkInterface and SystemState plain-data structures that capture a snapshot of host networking, session, and performance metrics for change detection and reporting.

name: MetricCache.h
summary: Generic, thread-safe TTL cache template that stores the last computed value of an expensive metric and only recomputes it once the configured time-to-live has elapsed, plus a CacheDurations namespace of per-metric TTL constants.

name: MetricsCollector.h
summary: Declares the MetricsCollector class, which orchestrates periodic collection of performance, GPU, process, and Windows Update metrics from a Platform implementation, with optional per-metric caching.

name: MetricsCollector.cpp
summary: Implements MetricsCollector's metric-gathering methods, calling into the Platform interface for CPU/RAM/disk/network/GPU/process/update data and assembling a formatted metrics string for transmission.

name: main.cpp
summary: Application entry point for the CoreStationHXAgent; bootstraps the platform abstraction, manages serial communication and heartbeat threads, handles AMT COM port detection/reassignment via the Windows registry, and relays system state to the CoreStation HX CMC over serial.

name: 3kcheck.h
summary: Windows-only header declaring CPUInfo and helper functions to retrieve CPU details and determine whether the host is an HX2K-class CPU configuration (vs. HX3K), used to select the correct serial COM port.

name: SerialManager.cpp
summary: Cross-platform implementation of serial port communication (open/close/read/write/reconnect) supporting both Windows (CreateFileA/HANDLE) and POSIX (termios) backends, with message framing and retry-delay-based reconnection logic.

name: SerialManager.h
summary: Declares the cross-platform SerialManager class, providing an interface for opening, closing, reading, writing, and auto-reconnecting a serial port, with platform-specific handle storage for Windows and POSIX.

name: version.h
summary: Defines the agent's version number components (major/minor/release/build/extraversion/RC/adhoc), the default serial port path, and a human-readable application description.

name: CMakeLists.txt
summary: CMake build configuration for CoreStationHXAgent: defines a C++17 executable target with platform-specific sources (Windows tray/session/regedit/metrics modules vs Linux platform code), parses version info from src/version.h, generates git_info.h with branch/hash/build time, sets compiler flags per platform/config, links Windows system libraries (iphlpapi, ws2_32, wtsapi32, etc.) or Linux dbus-1, and configures CPack packaging (WIX on Windows, DEB on Linux) plus optional install rules and test subdirectory.

name: README.md
summary: Primary project documentation describing the repository file layout, Linux build/install instructions (Ubuntu 24.04, debuild/.deb packaging, systemd service), and Windows build/usage instructions (build machine setup, day-to-day use, exe signing, service management, PowerShell execution policy, linting), plus reference tables for session-state and serial-output debug codes.

name: build.bat
summary: Windows batch script that initializes the MSVC build environment via vswhere/vcvarsall, configures and builds the CoreStationHXAgent CMake project in Release mode, locates the resulting executable, copies it (and release-notes.txt) into the installer directory, and reports build time and file size.

name: build.sh
summary: Linux/cross-compile shell script that generates git_info.h from current git branch/hash/build time, compiles Windows resources with windres, and cross-compiles a static Windows .exe using the MinGW-w64 toolchain (x86_64-w64-mingw32-g++-posix), linking the required Win32 system libraries.

name: release-notes.txt
summary: Chronological changelog of CoreStationHXAgent releases from version 2025.4.2 through 20.26.5.1_GA, documenting feature additions such as session-state reporting, heartbeat messages, Linux build support, EV signing, serial port COM assignment changes, and HX3000 CPU-based node detection.

name: setup-remotes.ps1
summary: One-time PowerShell setup script that configures git remotes after cloning, adding a GitHub mirror remote and a combined 'all' remote with push URLs pointing to both Bitbucket and GitHub.

name: sign.bat
summary: Minimal batch script intended to code-sign an executable via the smctl sign command using a configured key-pair alias; per the README this script is not currently used in the build process.

name: install.ps1
summary: Administrator-only PowerShell installer that cleanly removes any existing CoreStationService, copies the agent executable to C:\ProgramData\ahk, registers it as a Windows service with auto-restart failure recovery, and starts it.

name: release-notes.txt
summary: Chronological release notes for CoreStation HX Agent (installer copy), documenting version history from 2025.4.2 through 20.26.5.1_GA including HX3000 CPU-based COM port detection, heartbeat messaging, session reporting robustness, and Linux build support.

name: remove.ps1
summary: Administrator-only PowerShell uninstaller that stops and deletes the CoreStationService via sc.exe, verifies removal by polling Get-Service, and moves the leftover executable from C:\ProgramData\ahk to the temp directory.

name: .understandignore
summary: Ignore-pattern configuration for the understand-anything analysis tool, excluding build artifacts, dependencies, and generated files from codebase scanning.

name: app.rc
summary: Windows resource script defining the application icon and VERSIONINFO block (company, file/product version, description) for the CoreStationHXAgent executable, sourced from version.h macros.

name: app.res
summary: Compiled Windows resource binary produced from app.rc, embedding the application icon and version metadata into the final executable.

name: CoreStationHXAgent.service
summary: systemd unit file that runs the CoreStationHXAgent binary as a simple service on Linux, restarting on failure and starting at multi-user boot target.

name: changelog
summary: Debian package changelog recording version history entries for the corestationhxagent package.

name: clean
summary: Debian packaging file listing extra build artifacts to remove during the package clean step.

name: compat
summary: Specifies the debhelper compatibility level used when building the Debian package.

name: control
summary: Debian package control file declaring source/binary package metadata, maintainer, build dependencies (cmake, dh-cmake, debhelper), and runtime dependencies (network-manager, libdbus-1-3) for corestationhxagent.

name: copyright
summary: Debian copyright and licensing declaration for the corestationhxagent package and its included files.

name: dh-cmake.compat
summary: Compatibility version declaration for the dh-cmake debhelper sequence add-on used in the package build.

name: files
summary: Debhelper-generated registry of output package files produced during the Debian build process.

name: postinst
summary: Post-installation script that enables and (re)starts the CoreStationHXAgent systemd service after package install/configure, with verbose console banners for debugging.

name: postrm
summary: Post-removal script that cleans up service state (e.g., disabling/stopping CoreStationHXAgent.service) after the package is removed.

name: prerm
summary: Pre-removal script that stops the CoreStationHXAgent systemd service before the package files are removed.

name: rules
summary: Debian build rules makefile driving the package build via debhelper's dh command with CMake support, including an override to customize the auto-clean step.

name: format
summary: Declares the Debian source package format (typically 3.0 quilt) used when constructing the source package.

name: 3kcheck.cpp
summary: Windows-only CPU detection module that uses the __cpuid intrinsic to read CPU vendor/brand strings and determine whether the host is an HX2K-class CPU (Core Ultra 165H/165U/285H) versus HX3K, replacing an earlier NIC-based detection approach.

name: Regedit.cpp
summary: Implements the Regedit class's Windows Registry operations (Read, Write, Create, Delete), parsing root-key/subkey paths and using Win32 Reg* APIs with logging via the parent WindowsPlatform.

name: Regedit.h
summary: Declares the Regedit class providing a small cross-cutting API (Read/Write/Create/Delete) for Windows Registry access on behalf of the parent WindowsPlatform.

name: ServiceManager.cpp
summary: Implements the ServiceManager class, providing full Windows Service Control Manager (SCM) lifecycle handling: install/uninstall, start/stop, status query and reporting, the service main and control-handler callbacks, and Win32 error formatting helpers.

name: ServiceManager.h
summary: Declares the ServiceManager class and its nested ServiceConfig/ServiceStatus structs, exposing the full Windows Service lifecycle API (install, uninstall, start, stop, status query, SCM callbacks) used by the agent to run itself as a Windows service.

name: SessionMonitor.cpp
summary: Implements the SessionMonitor class: creates a hidden window subscribed to WTS session-change notifications (logon/logoff, lock/unlock, console/RDP connect) on a dedicated thread and reports state transitions via callback, plus a helper to query current session state including logged-in user and desktop type.

name: SessionMonitor.h
summary: Declares the SessionMonitor class, which watches Windows Terminal Services (WTS) session-state changes via a hidden window and reports them through a callback function.

name: TrayApp.cpp
summary: Implements the TrayApp class: manages a Windows system tray icon showing hostname/IP/uptime, running a UI thread for the tray window and a named-pipe listener thread that parses incoming key=value updates from the agent process to refresh the displayed tooltip.

name: TrayApp.h
summary: Declares the TrayApp class, which displays a Windows system tray icon with hostname/IP/uptime information updated via UI and named-pipe listener threads.

name: LinuxPlatform.cpp
summary: Linux-specific implementation of the Platform interface, providing serial port I/O, network interface enumeration, system metrics (CPU/RAM/disk/GPU), D-Bus session monitoring, and syslog-based logging for the host agent.

name: Windows_Addon.h
summary: Small header of Windows-specific RAII helpers: custom deleters for HANDLE and PDH_HQUERY smart pointers, and a COM library initializer/uninitializer wrapper.

name: WindowsPlatform.cpp
summary: Windows-specific implementation of the Platform interface and Windows Service entry point: handles SCM service lifecycle, serial port I/O, network/adapter enumeration via IP Helper API, WMI-based GPU driver queries, PDH performance counters, registry-based OS version detection, and high-RAM process discovery.

name: WindowsPlatform.h
summary: Declares the WindowsPlatform class implementing the Platform interface for Windows, including service-management members, PDH counters, COM initializer, metric caches, and Windows-specific helper methods.
